SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = 'completed' AND update_time >= #{beginDate}::date AND update_time < #{endDate}::date + interval '1 day'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = 'ongoing'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM proj_payment WHERE del_flag = '0' AND received_status = 'received' AND pay_time >= #{beginDate}::date AND pay_time < #{endDate}::date + interval '1 day'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM proj_payment WHERE del_flag = '0' AND received_status = 'received' AND pay_time >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(internal_output) + SUM(external_output), 0) AS amount FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{beginDate}::date AND create_time < #{endDate}::date + interval '1 day'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(internal_output) + SUM(external_output), 0) AS amount FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(contract_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(received_amount), 0) AS receivedAmount FROM proj_contract WHERE del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_contract WHERE del_flag = '0'

SELECT t.id, t.task_name AS taskName, p.project_name AS projectName, t.required_finish_date AS requiredFinishDate, t.status, (CURRENT_DATE - t.required_finish_date::date) AS overdueDays FROM proj_task t JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND p.del_flag = '0' AND t.actual_finish_date IS NULL AND t.required_finish_date IS NOT NULL AND t.required_finish_date < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY t.required_finish_date ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM proj_material WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY status

SELECT to_char(m, 'YYYY-MM') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(w.total_output), 0) AS output, COALESCE(SUM(p.total_payment), 0) AS payment FROM generate_series( date_trunc('month', #{beginDate}::date), date_trunc('month', #{endDate}::date), '1 month'::interval ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', create_time) AS mo, SUM(COALESCE(internal_output, 0) + COALESCE(external_output, 0)) AS total_output FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', create_time) ) w ON w.mo = m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', pay_time) AS mo, SUM(COALESCE(amount, 0)) AS total_payment FROM proj_payment WHERE del_flag = '0' AND received_status = 'received' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', pay_time) ) p ON p.mo = m GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

SELECT COALESCE(c.name, '未分类') AS name, COALESCE(SUM(w.internal_output) + SUM(w.external_output), 0) AS value FROM proj_workload w LEFT JOIN proj_category c ON c.id = w.category_id AND c.del_flag = '0' WHERE w.del_flag = '0' AND w.create_time >= #{beginDate}::date AND w.create_time < #{endDate}::date + interval '1 day' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT label, SUM(monthly) OVER (ORDER BY label ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative FROM ( SELECT to_char(m, 'YYYY-MM') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(w.total_output), 0) AS monthly FROM generate_series( date_trunc('year', #{beginDate}::date), date_trunc('month', #{endDate}::date), '1 month'::interval ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', create_time) AS mo, SUM(COALESCE(internal_output, 0) + COALESCE(external_output, 0)) AS total_output FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', create_time) ) w ON w.mo = m GROUP BY m ) t ORDER BY label

SELECT to_char(m, 'YYYY-MM') AS label, COALESCE(np.cnt, 0) AS newProjects, COALESCE(cp.cnt, 0) AS completedProjects FROM generate_series( date_trunc('month', #{beginDate}::date), date_trunc('month', #{endDate}::date), '1 month'::interval ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', create_time) AS mo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', create_time) ) np ON np.mo = m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', update_time) AS mo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = 'completed' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', update_time) ) cp ON cp.mo = m ORDER BY m

SELECT contract_no AS contractNo, contract_name AS contractName, COALESCE(contract_amount, 0) AS contractAmount, COALESCE(received_amount, 0) AS receivedAmount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(contract_amount, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(received_amount / contract_amount * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS progress FROM proj_contract WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY contract_amount DESC LIMIT 10
